name: Howl's Adventure
source:
Starring teenage Howl from Miyazaki's Howl's Moving Castle and four characters from Katawa Shoujo (plus one guest cg appearance), this short (<15 minutes) parody game has everything some things anyone could want, and lots that no one ever asked for!
[From [url=https://sinsisters.itch.io/howls-adventure-parody] itch.io[/url]]
